Listeners: input/change (capture), settings-context-changed, attendance-reward-saved, click (capture). Combined core edits pass click through; direct save stops propagation. contextGeneration protects later UI effects, not a claim that all old requests are cancelled. No exposed whole-controller disposal.

Static legacy HTML load; captures/replaces window.fetch for POST Player creation and exposes updatePlayerIdentity for reset. Credential event subscribers include createLifecycle and createUx; replacing reset alone is insufficient for removal.
Credential event closes creation modal. Body MutationObserver decorates added forms, capture click guards validation. Exports helpers, not disposer; observer is not disconnected in reviewed source.

Capture credential listener consumes lastCreateContext once, schedules confirmation; confirmation has close/destroy and focus handling. Top-level observer/click/submit/window listeners have no whole-module disposer. Blank creation fields are generated using browser crypto before server hashing. Do not change generation policy in a reset cleanup.

DOM MutationObserver + attendance-reward-saved + one-time load schedule error reconciliation and stylesheet load. No network request/global fetch assignment in this source. Whole observer disposal not exposed.
